qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow/Senior Research Fellow: Master's degree in Horticulture/Fruit Science/Genetics/Plant Breeding/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Plant Molecular Biology and Biotechnology/Life Sciences with 4/5 years bachelor's degree. Candidate must have a postgraduate degree in Basic Sciences with a 3-year bachelor's degree, and must have UGC/CSIR/ICAR NET, GATE qualification, or an equivalent, or a Ph.D. in any of the above disciplines. Field Assistant: B.Sc./3 years diploma in Engineering and Tech. Graduate degree in any discipline.

salary_details.details: Junior Research Fellow/Senior Research Fellow: Rs. 37000 + HRA (27%) for the first and second year and Rs. 42000 + HRA (27%) for the third year. Field Assistant: Rs. 20000 + HRA (27%).

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ICAR IARI Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ICAR IARI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow/Senior Research Fellow: Master's degree in Horticulture/Fruit Science/Genetics/Plant Breeding/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Plant Molecular Biology and Biotechnology/Life Sciences with 4/5 years bachelor's degree. Candidate must have a postgraduate degree in Basic Sciences with a 3-year bachelor's degree, and must have UGC/CSIR/ICAR NET, GATE qualification, or an equivalent, or a Ph.D. in any of the above disciplines. Field Assistant: B.Sc./3 years diploma in Engineering and Tech. Graduate degree in any discipline.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 50 years for all posts. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC as per Govt. of India/ICAR rules for JRF/SRF; Maximum 35 years for men and 40 years for women (JRF/SRF), 50 years (Field Assistant). Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow/Senior Research Fellow: Rs. 37000 + HRA (27%) for the first and second year and Rs. 42000 + HRA (27%) for the third year. Field Assistant: Rs. 20000 + HRA (27%).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR IARI recruitment is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow/Senior Research Fellow and Field Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for these positions at ICAR IARI.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for this recruitment by sending their application via email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Field Assistant post offers a salary of Rs. 20000 + HRA (27%) per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow/Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in specified disciplines with a 4/5 year bachelor's degree, or a postgraduate degree in Basic Sciences with a 3-year bachelor's degree and relevant qualifications like UGC/CSIR/ICAR NET, GATE, or a Ph.D. is required.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Field Assistant post is 50 years.

faq.question: Q8. When will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ICAR IARI recruitment will be held on 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute located?
faq.answer: The ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110012.
